about: Street Dynamics object library. Units SI (m, kg, N, Pa, rad). Sources and estimates per entry; docs/README.md lists them.

steel_tube_galv.source: Galvanised conduit tube (ABNT NBR 5580) has no specified yield; 200-250 MPa assumed (cf. NBR 5590 / ASTM A53 Gr. B, 240 MPa). Hinge ductility estimated (a tube folds flat before it tears).

steel_s235.source: Structural steel S235 / ASTM A36-class; bike racks and steel bollards.

cast_iron_grey.source: Grey cast iron: tensile 150-250 MPa, modulus of rupture in bending higher; 250 MPa taken. Brittle: snaps.

concrete_precast.source: C30 precast: flexural tensile (modulus of rupture) ~4.5 MPa (EN 1992 f_ctm 2.9 MPa x size effect); light reinforcement keeps ~15 % (estimated).

stop_sign_r1.name: Stop sign (R-1 PARE)
stop_sign_r1.source: CONTRAN MBST Vol. I: R-1 urban side >= 0.25 m (0.604 m across the flats); bottom edge >= 2.10 m (MBST Vol. III; CET-SP 2.10-2.30 m). Plate 1.25 mm galvanised steel (NBR 11904). Post 2 1/2 in x 2.65 mm (Detran-PR spec). Footing 0.30 x 0.30 x 0.60 m concrete; its rotation in soil under a sidewalk slab estimated.

regulatory_r19.name: Speed limit (R-19)
regulatory_r19.source: MBST Vol. I: circular regulatory signs >= 0.40 m urban; 0.50 m taken. Post and footing as the R-1.

warning_diamond.name: Warning sign (diamond)
warning_diamond.source: Warning signs: 0.50 m side (0.71 m across the corners), estimated for urban streets. Post and footing as the R-1.

street_name_double.name: Street-name plates (two)
street_name_double.source: CET-SP street-name plates 80 x 40 cm (also 64 x 30 cm); post DN65 76.1 x 3.35 mm (NBR 5580 class L).

sign_slip_base.name: Sign on a breakaway slip base
sign_slip_base.source: A breakaway support for comparison (not common on São Paulo streets). Release shear estimated; MASH stub limit 102 mm.

bollard_cast_iron.name: Cast-iron bollard (frade)
bollard_cast_iron.source: Commercial cast-iron frade 69 cm x 9 cm (Brazilian catalogue). Set in concrete; footing estimated.

bollard_steel.name: Steel bollard (concrete filled)
bollard_steel.source: 4 in (114.3 mm) x 6 mm concrete-filled steel bollard in a 0.4 m footing, typical of sidewalk protection; not a rated (ASTM F2656) anti-ram bollard. Footing estimated.

bollard_concrete.name: Precast concrete bollard
bollard_concrete.source: Precast concrete bollard 30 x 60 cm (SINAPI 103309), set in the sidewalk; footing estimated.

bike_rack_u.name: Bike rack (inverted U)
bike_rack_u.source: CET-SP paraciclo: inverted U, ~50 mm tube, 0.75-0.90 m high, 0.6-1.0 m wide; 2 mm wall (vendor).
